name: Stages
description: The Mutational Stages mark the Maw's ascent into true power. Ascending to a higher Stage expands its capacity, allowing it to bind more numerous and potent Mutations, while empowering those already etched into its form. To unlock each Stage, you must claim the essence of a specific Boss. Any hunter who wounds the Boss while bearing the Maw, by whatever weapon, shares in the feast, even if another delivers the final blow. When the beast ascends, soul fire rushes up and a title is branded upon the air.
